name: Oaxacan Gold
summary: **Oaxacan Gold** is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] traditionally grown in the Oaxaca highlands of [[country:MX|Mexico]]. [[breeder:Cryptic Labs]] later stabilized a seed version from Oaxacan Pearl Stem, Oaxacan Gold, and Oaxacan Red plant lines. It is grown as a pure [[label:sativa|sativa]] and has been crossed into strains such as Demon Latcher.
